app_tagline: [தமிழ்] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [தமிழ்] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [தமிழ்] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [தமிழ்] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [தமிழ்] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [தமிழ்] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [தமிழ்] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [தமிழ்] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [தமிழ்] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [தமிழ்] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [தமிழ்] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [தமிழ்] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [தமிழ்] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [தமிழ்] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [தமிழ்] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [தமிழ்] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [தமிழ்] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [தமிழ்] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [தமிழ்] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [தமிழ்] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [தமிழ்] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [தமிழ்] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [தமிழ்] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [தமிழ்] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [தமிழ்] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [தமிழ்] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [தமிழ்] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [தமிழ்] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [தமிழ்] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [ta] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [ta] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [ta] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [ta] Type or speak your question for the helper...
